label: B25-COREMARK-UART-FIX-BOARD-AND-GOLDEN
title: Run corrected B25 t/v/c once and restore exact golden after the Blaster is present
authorization: Consumes user's earlier authorization for volatile Quartus/JTAG testing, limited to one candidate program, one terminal t/v/c session, and one golden restoration.
writes: task-owned board contract and run artifacts
scope: After GamePC enumerates the MPSSE Blaster, run one sealed candidate transaction with t/v/c in one terminal session, strictly parse CoreMark raw and summary fields, then restore and prove exact golden.
acceptance: t signature PASS; v CRC selfcheck PASS/INVALID; c official CRC/seed/output and >=250M 25MHz target cycles produce parser-recomputed VALID score; final exact golden proven; prohibited counts zero.
failure_policy: Stop on first failed predicate, preserve evidence, consume only the one golden restoration budget, and never retry candidate/terminal/CoreMark in the same task.
forbidden_regions: cached design hash as live proof
preflight_gate: Require present-only FTDI 0403:6014 enumeration, exact MPSSE cable/JTAG ID/UART/PHY, clean EDA/port state and exact candidate/golden SOF files. User-attested Flash boot of VexRiscv/Linux is an explicitly scoped T-053 initial-state policy; standard-server design hash is logged as diagnostic only. Final exact-golden programmer transaction and postflight remain mandatory.

dispatch.monitoring: one uninterrupted GamePC lock; remote AST/seal and present-only preflight before candidate programming

result.terminal_response_regex_deviation: 120-column Windows console redraw; raw transcript passed strict normalized parser; no retry
